featured_reviews.name: Rajat Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very pleasant shopping experience at Reliance Smart. The store was well-organized, clean, and easy to navigate, which made finding products convenient and hassle-free. The variety of items available, especially in groceries and daily essentials, was impressive, and the quality met my expectations.
I would also like to appreciate the staff for being courteous and helpful. They were attentive and ready to assist whenever needed, which enhanced the overall experience. The billing process was smooth and efficient, with minimal waiting time.
However, there is still some scope for improvement in maintaining consistent stock availability for certain popular items. Apart from that, everything was excellent.
Overall, I am satisfied with my visit and would definitely recommend Reliance Smart to others for a comfortable and reliable shopping experience.

featured_reviews.name: Durvankur Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ever since Reliance Smart has moved up to the 2nd floor, it has become more organised, and spacious. The items that you are looking for are generally available, but some you might find under combo offers only, or in large packs. The prices obviously are a little higher than D-Mart, and their offers don't entice me ever.

The best thing about Reliance is that it is less crowded than D-Mart, and you can shop peacefully. I guess it is the extra price you pay for. Their rewards system is a joke. In the last year and a half, we must have shopped closed to around Rs.13-15K, and all that we see in our rewards list is a reimbursement amount of Rs. 150.

featured_reviews.review_text: I went to Star Bazaar recently and really liked how organised the store is. Everything from vegetables and snacks to home essentials is easy to find, and the shelves are well-stocked. The quality of fresh items is good, and the prices are affordable with frequent offers. featured_reviews.name: Anugraha Ghale
featured_reviews.review_text:
There’s something oddly calming about walking into a good supermarket. great supermarket inside Utopia Mall… spacious, well-organized, and full of variety. They have everything from fresh greens and salads to household essentials and kitchen items. I loved that they use paper bags for vegetables instead of plastic. Then the aisles opened up to everything else, dairy, grains, cleaning supplies, doormats, kitchen utensils, the whole rhythm of daily life, just sitting there on shelves.

The space itself was surprisingly open bright, The staff were kind and helpful, and even though they check your bill at the exit, it’s done politely and quickly. Good place to stop by even for cultural enrichment.

Location is super. Atmosphere is best. Materials is of quality. Staff training is necessary. Security staff needs more HR training.
As per the items, Allmost all home needs are there. But some changes needs to be done. Varieties of papad is less. Only masala papad available. Normal papad is not available. Display of items are also not proper.
Staff training is required as too many are working in one place. Vegetable weighing counter staff are less which takes more time for customers.
The phone number of customers are recorded in the billing counter. But not displayed in the bill. It will be a useful one.    Rates are really best and economical. Needs to publicise the same to reach people. Which will make more customers to reach.
Billing is to be improved. Fast and perfect will bring a long time happy customers

featured_reviews.name: Kuldeep Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
To D K Shop Owner,
I feel terrible about my visit to your shop today. This was the first time I went without my wife. We usually buy goods worth ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 every one or two months.
I always pay with GPay, but today I got the bank PIN and the GPay PIN mixed up. After three wrong attempts, my card got blocked. I called my wife and explained that it would take some time because my card was blocked.
My wife then said, "Please let me talk to the cashier; I will tell them that we will pay when we get home." But the cashier said you don't trust customers. You don't even offer home delivery.
We spend ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 at your shop every year. Don't you have any trust in us? Don't you people have any shame?

featured_reviews.name: Himadri Chatterjee
featured_reviews.review_text: Had the most wonderful experience with Rubina Shaikh who helped me create 3 hampers. She was knowledgeable about all items, suggested the most suitable items for my budget. She was also very patient as I made changes to the hampers, for which she had to pack, unpack and re-pack the hampers. I never felt pressured to purchase any item, she ensured everything was within my budget. I really enjoyed my experience at the store and especially the warm, competent and helpful service from Rubina Shaikh

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: A wide range of cheese varieties. Best place to get all types of European cheese, Pastas and sauces. They also have cheese platters and customised gifting options.

review_photos.caption: Cheese board was made using Gouda, Cheddar, Manchego, Burrata and blue cheese. All from food Square. All of them were flavourful. Quite a good variety.

featured_reviews.name: Nishta Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
They have a variety of products, however everything is sooo much more expensive compared to what they would actually be sold for in pounds or euros considering there are a lot of imported products. But when i say more expensive I mean DOUBLE the price, what you could’ve bought after converting to inr for 300 at this place its for 799 and such ridiculous prices. However if youre willing to pay double they have a great curation of products.
The worst part however is that the fruits a lot of them had fungus on them even though the variety is good a lot of their fruits had fungus. HOWEVER, THE CHEESE AND DIP TASTE TESTERS WERE AMAZING!!

featured_reviews.name: Sphurti Joglekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had good experiences at Food Square Worli in the past — the staff is usually polite and the product selection is great.

However, my recent visit left me quite disappointed and feeling cheated. While browsing, I accidentally stepped back and a truffle salt bottle (1500rs) that was placed right at the edge of a shelf fell and broke. Staff and customers nearby agreed it wasn’t my fault. I requested a review of the CCTV footage, but was told the store manager wasn’t available.

Despite that, I was asked to pay 100% first and then settled on 50% of the product’s cost and was given a broken, partially empty container (which on request they changed to a coffee plastic cup)— which I now can’t even use safely due to concerns about glass shards.

This could have been handled more fairly. I hope the store reviews its shelf arrangements and customer service protocols for such incidents.

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Saranya Sasi
featured_reviews.review_text: FoodSquare Worli, nestled within IKEA, has elevated my gourmet shopping experience! This culinary haven boasts an impressive array of artisanal delights, from specialty cheeses to craft chocolates. The meticulously curated selection of international gourmet products, including organic and vegan options, caters to diverse palates. Knowledgeable staff readily offer recommendations, ensuring a personalized shopping experience. The modern, sleek ambiance and well-organized display make browsing a pleasure. Competitive pricing and regular promotions add value. FoodSquare Worli has become my one-stop destination for gourmet gifts, cooking essentials, and indulgent treats. Whether a food connoisseur or enthusiastic home cook, this gem is a must-visit.
